summary: Probably John's 3rd cousin 4x removed; Civil War musician, 149th PA 'Bucktails', 1862-65.
bio:
Andrew Croop (b. 1843) served as musician, Co. F, 149th PA ('Bucktails'), 22 Aug 1862 - 24 Jun 1865, 'to the close of the war'; later 15 years a school director. Bradsby names brothers Alvin and Simon as also serving.

Bradsby says Andrew, Hiram's brother, was a shoemaker by trade. In September 1866 he married Sophia Bonham, daughter of Joseph and Christine Bonham, and they had six children, two of whom (George M. and Maud) were living in 1893. In 1876 he moved from his father's farm to an 80-acre place of his own, and he ran a portable sawmill. He belonged to the G.A.R. and Jr. O.U.A.M. and served as school director for fifteen years, as well as secretary of the school board and township clerk ([R4-S1]). In July 1900 he was a candidate for Luzerne County jury commissioner ([R4-S2]).
sources: [R4-S1] H. C. Bradsby, History of Luzerne County (1893), pp.584 and 812-813 (Hiram and Andrew Croop biographies) (secondary) https://archive.org/details/historyofluzerne00brad
